title: Belgian parliament to vote on divisive new law allowing police raids on people’s homes, if they are suspected of harbouring an undocumented migrant
lede: “The Belgian government may call them ‘home visits’, but that doesn’t change what they are: police forcibly entering private homes and traumatising families and children to arrest people", said one critic of the bill.
